request: Remove the largest radius that is all around the part and replace it by the same size radius as others. That means in cross section all radiuses will be the same for the profile.

actions.target: The largest radius that extends all around the part.
actions.relational_constraint: The target radius must be the circumferential radius described as being all around the part.
actions.unresolved_reference: Resolved as F005, the continuous radius-10 mm large rounded outer transition. The 63 mm and 50 mm values on F001 and F002 are plan-view corner radii, not cross-sectional edge radii. The other continuous cross-sectional fillets F006, F007, and F008 are radius 2 mm.
steps: Select section R01, the closed-loop perimeter body, and identify feature F005 by its continuous radius-10 mm outer transition between the outer perimeter wall F001 and the opposing narrow mounting land F004.

Confirm the target using the B-rep geometry: FACE 36, FACE 38, FACE 40, and FACE 42 are radius-10 mm cylindrical straight portions, while FACE 35, FACE 37, FACE 39, and FACE 41 are toroidal corner portions with a 10 mm minor radius. Together they form one uninterrupted rounded-rectangular loop.

Do not modify the radius-63 mm outer outline corners of F001 or the radius-50 mm aperture corners of F002; those dimensions define the rounded-rectangular path in plan view rather than the requested profile radius.
If the parametric feature history is available, suppress or delete the fillet operation that created F005 while retaining the underlying outer wall F001 and narrow mounting land F004.

If operating directly on the imported B-rep, remove FACE 35 through FACE 42 as a connected tangent face set and extend or replace the adjacent surfaces of F001 and F004 until they intersect at the original unfilleted continuous perimeter edge.

Heal and sew the reconstructed faces into SOLID 0, verifying that the result remains a single watertight closed-loop solid and that the broad seating land F003, narrow mounting land F004, aperture wall F002, and existing radius-2 mm fillets F006 through F008 remain intact.

actions.operation: Replace the removed radius with a radius matching the size of the other radii.

parameters.radius: 2 mm, matching the common minor radius of F006, F007, and F008

actions.target: The geometry formerly occupied by the removed largest radius.
actions.relational_constraint: The replacement radius must equal the other profile radii so that all radii visible in cross section are the same.
actions.unresolved_reference: Resolved: 'others' refers to the three existing continuous edge-fillet loops F006, F007, and F008, each having a 2 mm cross-sectional radius. Apply the replacement to the same complete perimeter loop formerly occupied by F005.
steps: Use the sharp continuous edge reconstructed between the outer perimeter wall F001 and the opposing narrow mounting land F004 as the edge chain for the replacement fillet. FACE 34 is the planar mounting land adjacent to the original F005 transition.

Select the complete tangent-connected rounded-rectangular edge loop, including all four straight runs and all four plan-view corner transitions. Do not apply the operation to only one side or one corner.

Create a constant-radius edge fillet with radius 2 mm. This value is established by the cylindrical and toroidal minor radii of F006, F007, and F008 and is therefore the common size of the other profile radii.

Allow the fillet to propagate continuously around the loop. The replacement should generate radius-2 mm cylindrical faces along the straight portions and toroidal faces with a 2 mm minor radius through the four rounded plan-view corners.

Maintain tangency to both the repaired outer wall F001 and mounting land F004. Preserve the existing rounded-rectangular perimeter path and do not substitute the path radii of 63 mm, 61 mm, 53 mm, 52 mm, or 50 mm for the requested 2 mm cross-sectional fillet radius.

Rebuild and validate SOLID 0. Confirm that no residual radius-10 mm surfaces corresponding to original FACE 35 through FACE 42 remain and that the replacement transition is continuous without gaps or self-intersections.

Inspect representative transverse cross sections through a straight side and through a rounded corner. Verify that the modified outer transition and the existing fillet loops F006, F007, and F008 all have a 2 mm profile radius.

Review the +Z, -Z, +Y, -Y, and isometric views to confirm that the edit is applied all around the frame while the central aperture, annular lands, outer dimensions, and rounded-rectangular outline remain otherwise unchanged.

intention: Make all radii in the profile cross section the same size.
